dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Hello, this is Susan from the Palm Hotel in Phuket. Can I speak to Mr. Davis?
dialogue.reading: həˈloʊ, ðɪs ɪz ˈsuːzən frəm ðə ˈpɑːm hoʊˈtɛl ɪn puːˈkɛt. kən aɪ ˈspiːk tə ˈmɪstər ˈdeɪvɪs?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I'm sorry, he's out of the office today. He has a meeting at the head office.
dialogue.reading: aɪm ˈsɑːri, hiːz ˈaʊt əv ði ˈɔːfɪs təˈdeɪ. hiː ˈhæz ə ˈmiːtɪŋ ət ðə ˈhɛd ˈɔːfɪs.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Oh. It's urgent. When will he be back?
dialogue.reading: ˈoʊ. ɪts ˈɜːrdʒənt. ˈwɛn wɪl hiː bi ˈbæk?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Tomorrow morning. Would you like him to call you back?
dialogue.reading: təˈmɑːroʊ ˈmɔːrnɪŋ. wʊd juː ˈlaɪk hɪm tə ˈkɔːl juː ˈbæk?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Yes, please. Please tell him to call me as soon as he gets back.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, ˈpliːz. ˈpliːz ˈtɛl hɪm tə ˈkɔːl miː əz ˈsuːn əz hiː ˈɡɛts ˈbæk.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Of course. I'll give him your message as soon as he arrives.
dialogue.reading: əv ˈkɔːrs. aɪl ˈɡɪv hɪm jʊr ˈmɛsɪdʒ əz ˈsuːn əz hiː əˈraɪvz.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Thank you. Can he get back to me before ten? I have another meeting at ten.
dialogue.reading: ˈθæŋk juː. kən hiː ˈɡɛt ˈbæk tə miː bɪˈfɔːr ˈtɛn? aɪ ˈhæv əˈnʌðər ˈmiːtɪŋ ət ˈtɛn.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I'm sure he can. I'll tell him it's urgent.
dialogue.reading: aɪm ˈʃʊr hiː ˈkæn. aɪl ˈtɛl hɪm ɪts ˈɜːrdʒənt.
